brief:
Israeli forces conducted widespread operations across the occupied West Bank on Tuesday, abducting nine Palestinians during community invasions, IMEMC News reported. The military imposed movement restrictions in multiple areas and bulldozed Palestinian land as part of the operations.

Jewish colonizers attacked Palestinians in separate incidents, damaging property and seizing livestock, according to the report. The coordinated activity reflected an escalation in Israeli military and settler operations across Palestinian territories.
dek: Israeli forces invaded communities across the occupied West Bank, abducted nine Palestinians, imposed movement restrictions and bulldozed Palestinian land. Colonizers also attacked Palestinians, damaged property and stole livestock.
title: Israeli forces invade West Bank, abduct nine Palestinians
